class.name: DisDataPdu
class.brief_description: Data PDU (type 20): values sent in answer to a request or unsolicited.
class.description: A Data PDU carries datum records as the answer to a Data Query or Set Data request, or unsolicited. [member DisSimulationManagementPdu.request_id] repeats the request's ID when it is an answer.

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as a Data PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid Data PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], fewer than 40 bytes, or datum counts and datum records that do not fit in the length). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size. Bytes after the last datum, up to the length field, are kept in [member DisPduBase.trailing_bytes].
